While underway, four perpetrators armed with long knives 
were sighted in the steering gear room. The ship's general 
alarm was activated and crew mustered. After conducting a 
search onboard, master confirmed there was no further 
sighting of the perpetrators and nothing was stolen.  A crew 
member was slightly injured when running away from the 
perpetrators with a minor laceration to his head, and the 
agent arranged for shore medical follow up.
The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety 
broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all 
vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. 
The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. 
Information was shared with the Indonesian authority.
